description: Spends credits (150, plus 50 for each extra animation, at most 2). Draws one character from a description in a chosen style with idle, run and attack animations and delivers the sheet, GIFs, frames and JSON via get_sprite_status. confirmCredits must equal the price; the same requestId returns the same order and charges nothing. Only one paid sprite order is open per account at a time. Without an API key nothing is spent: you get the price and links for the user.

confirmCredits.description: The exact price you showed the user. Required with an API key.

fromRunId.description: A finished web preview of the same character: keeps its character and idle sheet, so only the rest is drawn.

requestId.description: Required with an API key. A new one for each new purchase, the same one to retry.

name: generate_sprite_sheet
title: Generate a game sprite sheet
